name: Calmer Feed
audience: 从其他社交平台迁移、厌倦算法推荐的人

promotionalText.zh-Hans: 厌倦了算法推荐？Moro 的时间线按时间顺序呈现你关注的人，没有推荐、没有广告、不追踪。带上任意 Mastodon 服务器的账号，安静地读，好好地聊。
promotionalText.en-US: Tired of algorithmic feeds? Moro shows the people you follow in time order, with no recommendations, no ads and no tracking. Bring an account from any Mastodon server.
